valid_labelled_words.description: Total number of valid labelled binary words of length 16 with no cyclic run of three equal bits.

rotation_fixed_counts.description: Index k is the count of valid words fixed by rotation by k positions (word[i] == word[(i+k) mod 16]).

reflection_fixed_counts.description: Index k is the count of valid words fixed by the reflection through index k (word[i] == word[(k-i) mod 16]).

burnside_numerator.description: Sum of all 32 rotation and reflection fixed-point counts.

orbit_count.description: Number of dihedral orbits on valid words.

canonical_representatives.description: Sorted list of the lexicographically least representative of every orbit.

evidence.description: One descriptor binding the evidence file at evidence/answer.txt by its sha256 digest. The referenced file must be a single JSON object with exactly the keys schema_version ("1"), task_id, result (the same result object), and limitations (the same limitations list).

result.description: The same result object placed in submission.json.

evidenceContent.description: Required shape of the JSON object stored in evidence/answer.txt; the verifier enforces this exact four-key contract.
